question: What happens to my power during a grid outage?
model_answer:
When the grid goes down, your battery takes over. [how-it-works]

Additionally, the backup is automatic and fast:
*   "Your backup kicks in, usually under half a second." [how-it-works]
*   "When the grid goes down, your battery takes over instantly. Most members don't even notice." [home]

question: How long will the battery power my home during an outage?
model_answer:
A single battery can back up your home up to 36 hours. Exact runtime depends on your power usage. [how-it-works]

Additionally, the [home] page states that the backup duration is "Approx. 36-72 hours (1-2 batteries)."

question: How much does Base cost?
model_answer: The cost varies by location and plan, but the sample plan (Oncor territory) details include: "Backup battery: $695 one-time installation" [home], "$19/mo monthly membership fee" [home], and "Energy: 13.9¢/kWh" [home].
